playerReachDetail: A player who wins a governorship or a legislative seat acts on the list their office reads. A governor never sees transit, bridges, broadband, water service lines, disaster recovery, utility resilience or critical infrastructure.

surface.detail: The governor's office screen offers program subjects as choices; a legislator's drafting table lists every configuration.

system.detail: Two program lists. A governing office draws its first-year agenda and every budget season from src/simulation/governing/program-families.ts (13 families: service, fiscal and administration). A legislature drafts from src/simulation/legislation-program-families.ts (20: the same 13 plus infrastructure and resilience).
